newsitem.title: USA: Corporate yankee debt offerings stir up activity.
newsitem.headline: Corporate yankee debt offerings stir up activity.

text.p: A number of yankee debt offerings have managed to stir up activity in the corporate bond primary market as domestic players remain on the sidelines, dealers said.
"It's a quiet time in the (U.S.) market right now...this gives yankee offerings a bigger audience," one syndicate source said.
On Tuesday, European Investment Bank priced $1.0 billion in AAA/AAA rated 10-year global bonds to yield 17 basis points over Treasuries via joint managers CS First Boston and Lehman Brothers.
